text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hic... So good! Thank you for giving up your freedom, oh delicious fishies!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Why wouldn't I be?! I must show my
gratitude to
the great sea bream!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Every day they lay themselves down on a
hot iron
plate, never moving a muscle!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There they lie, sacrificing their lives for
us...
Obviously we should show gratitude
when
consuming them!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, I thought taiyaki were just shaped like fish... You're telling me they're real?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wow... talk about cringe. I legit just
figured that
out.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We can't let their sacrifices be in vain!
Now,
promise you will appreciate the
flavor of taiyaki!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, taiyaki! May your flavor
continue to
satisfy me for eons to come!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're the real GOAT here,
taiyaki! We
stan!
